business_summary: China Merchants Property Operation & Service Co., Ltd. engages in the real estate development and management. It also offers property and asset management services, and other services. The company was formerly known as AVIC SUNDA Holding Company Limited and changed its name to China Merchants Property Operation and Service Co., Ltd. in December 2019. China Merchants Property Operation & Service Co., Ltd. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
business_summary_ko: China Merchants Property Operation & Service Co., Ltd.는 부동산 개발 및 관리에 종사합니다. 또한 자산 및 자산 관리 서비스와 기타 서비스도 제공합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 AVIC SUNDA Holding Company Limited로 알려졌으며 2019년 12월에 China Merchants Property Operation and Service Co., Ltd.로 이름을 변경했습니다. China Merchants Property Operation & Service Co., Ltd.는 1985년에 설립되었으며 중국 심천에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
